name: How much does it cost to add a guest suite to a house in Las Vegas?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to add a guest suite to a house in Las Vegas?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of adding a guest suite in Las Vegas varies significantly based on size, features, and chosen finishes. A basic 300-400 sq ft suite might start around $75,000 to $100,000, while larger, more luxurious additions with high-end materials, a full kitchen, or custom amenities could exceed $200,000. Factors like plumbing extensions, electrical upgrades, foundation work, and permits also influence the total cost. It's essential to get a detailed quote tailored to your specific project needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a guest suite addition in Las Vegas range from $75,000 for basic designs to over $200,000 for larger or luxury options, depending on size, features, and finishes.
